% Pattern: head/forms. A head after \bigbreak on the line before it, a
% period between the number and the name, as "Theorem 1.1. (Main Theorem)",
% a title in a group after a font switch, as "\bf {Theorem A}.", a number in a
% word, as "Theorem One", and the misspelled title "Corrolary". Seen in the
% gold pilot (set X).
% want head-1 statement/theorem 1.1
% want head-2 statement/lemma 2.2
% want head-3 statement/theorem A
% want head-4 statement/theorem One
% want head-5 statement/corollary 1.4
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
We state the results of the paper.

\noindent{\bf Theorem 1.1. (Main Theorem)} \ \ \ {\it Every compact space is
bounded.}

\bigbreak
\noindent{\bf Lemma 2.2.} \ \ \ {\it Every finite space is compact.}

\noindent
\bf {Theorem A}. \\
{\it \rm Every closed part of a compact space is compact.}

{\bf Theorem One.} Every bounded closed set of the line is compact.

\noindent{\bf Corrolary 1.4.} {\it Every finite set of the line is compact.}
\end{document}
